items.title: Pure desi ghee
items.text: Never vanaspati. Never palm oil. Our ghee comes from one dairy in Anand.

items.title: Made this morning
items.text: What doesn't sell by 8 pm goes to the Dadar gurudwara — never back on the shelf.

items.title: Same-day delivery

sections.title: Book a free *tasting*
sections.text: Planning a wedding, a pooja or corporate Diwali gifts? Come taste with us and we'll plan the boxes together.

items.q: How long do the sweets stay fresh?
items.a: Milk sweets are best within 3 days and should go in the fridge. Kaju katli, soan papdi and namkeen keep for 2 to 3 weeks.
Dry sweets, namkeen and gift boxes ship across India in 2 to 5 days. Milk sweets are Mumbai-only.

items.q: Can I pay by UPI or cash?
items.a: Yes. Pay by any UPI app, cash on delivery for orders up to ₹5,000, or order on WhatsApp.
